question: Best dorm life in South Florida?
vote_note: Tag a senior who's already picking out dorm decor. 🛏️

a.label: FIU
a.name: Florida International University
bullets: Panther Hall: suite-style and just for first-year students (392 residents)
First-years don't have to live on campus, but FIU encourages it
Last cycle's priority housing deadline: April 10 (after the $200 admissions deposit)

b.label: FAU
b.name: Florida Atlantic University
bullets: No live-on requirement at the Boca campus (Wilkes Honors College excepted)
Newest: Talon Hall (fall 2026) with a sun deck, fire pit, grills and free laundry

second.title: Neither school makes freshmen live on campus. 👀
